description: Newlines inside an interpolation in an object element are ignored
notes: The newline is between the object's braces, where the prose says newlines are ignored as whitespace, but it is also inside a quoted template, which the spec describes as a single-line expression, and the spec doesn't say that interpolation sequences ignore newlines. hashicorp/hcl ignores newlines inside interpolations, even inside an object constructor whose own newlines are significant: parseTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go calls PushIncludeNewlines(false) before parsing the expression.
